title: Talking Head Synthesis with Facial Landmark Guidance via 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: arXiv:2609.17422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Audio-driven digital human generation plays an important role in virtual communication, immersive interaction, and media production. With the development of Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), recent talking-head systems have obtained more faithful 3D facial geometry and appearance modeling. A remaining difficulty is that speech features mainly describe temporal acoustic patterns rather than explicit facial layouts. As a result, directly driving 3D facial deformation with audio may produce inaccurate mouth motion, weak expression details, and local artifacts. To address this issue, we propose a facial-keypoint-guided spatial enhancement module. The predicted landmarks provide structural cues for selecting and enriching spatial points around expression-sensitive facial regions. translated_title: 基于3D高斯泼溅与面部关键点引导的说话人头像合成
translated_abstract: 音频驱动的数字人生成在虚拟交流、沉浸式交互和媒体制作中扮演着重要角色。随着神经辐射场（NeRF）和3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）技术的发展，近期的说话人头像系统获得了更逼真的3D面部几何与外观建模。然而，一个仍然存在的难题是，语音特征主要描述时序声学模式而非显式的面部布局。因此，直接用音频驱动3D面部变形可能产生不准确的嘴部运动、微弱的表达细节以及局部伪影。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个面部关键点引导的空间增强模块。预测的面部关键点为选择和丰富表情敏感面部区域周围的空间点提供结构线索。我们进一步引入了全局关键点补偿机制，将全部关键点集合编码为一个条件向量以……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于3D高斯泼溅的说话人头像合成方法，通过面部关键点引导的空间增强模块和全局关键点补偿机制，有效解决了音频直接驱动3D面部变形导致的嘴部运动不准确、表情细节不足和局部伪影问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a 3D Gaussian Splatting-based talking head synthesis method that leverages a facial-keypoint-guided spatial enhancement module and a global landmark compensation mechanism to address inaccurate mouth motion, weak expression details, and local artifacts caused by directly driving 3D facial deformation with audio.
